# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 11
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Community Rule Column 11 where the three translators significantly diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 11:1 | "I-will-sing with-knowledge" | "I will sing with knowledge" | "I will sing with understanding" | Word choice | LOGOS — da'at is "knowledge" not "understanding" |
| 2 | 11:2 | "the-flute-of my-lips I-will-raise in-His-just-measure" | "the flute of my lips I will raise in His just measure" | "the song on my lips I will lift up to His perfect standard" | Word choice | LOGOS — "flute of my lips" preserves the Hebrew metaphor (chalil) |
| 3 | 11:3 | "With-the-coming-of day-and-night" | "With the coming of day and night" | "When day and night arrive" | Structural | LOGOS — formal register maintained for liturgical formula |
| 4 | 11:5 | "the-perfection-of my-way" | "the perfection of my way" | "the wholeness of my path" | Word choice | LOGOS — tom = "perfection" in DSS idiom, not merely "wholeness" |
| 5 | 11:6 | "my-transgression shall-be-blotted-out" | "my transgression shall be blotted out" | "He will wipe away my sin" | Structural | LOGOS — passive preserves Hebrew niphal; PNEUMA shifts to active |
| 6 | 11:7 | "from-the-source-of His-knowledge He-has-opened my-light" | "from the source of His knowledge He has opened my light" | "He has opened my eyes from the wellspring of His wisdom" | Interpretive | LOGOS — "opened my light" preserves the unusual Hebrew idiom; PNEUMA normalizes to "opened my eyes" |
| 7 | 11:8 | "the-mystery-of what-shall-be" | "the mystery of what shall be" | "the mystery of what is to come" | Word choice | LOGOS — "what shall be" is standard for raz nihyeh |
| 8 | 11:9 | "He-that-is everlasting" | "He that is everlasting" | "The Eternal One" | Word choice | LOGOS — preserves the participial construction of the Hebrew |
| 9 | 11:9 | "on-a-rock-of strength is-the-way-of my-steps" | "on a rock of strength is the way of my steps" | "my steps rest upon an unshakable rock" | Structural | LOGOS — PNEUMA inverts Hebrew word order and adds "unshakable" |
| 10 | 11:11 | "the-truth-of God — that is-the-rock-of my-steps" | "the truth of God — that is the rock of my steps" | "God's truth — that is the bedrock beneath my feet" | Word choice | LOGOS — "rock of my steps" is the Hebrew idiom; "bedrock beneath my feet" is interpretive |
| 11 | 11:12 | "from-the-source-of His-righteousness is-my-judgment" | "from the source of His righteousness is my judgment" | "from the wellspring of His righteousness flows my vindication" | Word choice | LOGOS — mishpat = "judgment" not "vindication"; PNEUMA imports forensic sense |
| 12 | 11:14 | "knowledge and-prudent-understanding" | "knowledge and prudent understanding" | "insight and deep understanding" | Word choice | LOGOS — "prudent understanding" closer to sekhel binah |
| 13 | 11:15 | "a-fountain-of righteousness and-reservoir-of strength" | "a fountain of righteousness and reservoir of strength" | "a wellspring of right living and a deep reserve of power" | Word choice | LOGOS — "righteousness" and "strength" preserve Hebrew tsedaqah and gevurah |
| 14 | 11:16 | "hidden from-the-assembly-of flesh" | "hidden from the assembly of flesh" | "hidden from those bound to the flesh" | Interpretive | LOGOS — "assembly of flesh" preserves sod basar; PNEUMA paraphrases |
| 15 | 11:18 | "the-sons-of heaven He-has-associated their-assembly" | "the Sons of Heaven He has associated their assembly" | "the angels of heaven He has joined their fellowship" | Word choice | SOPHIA compromise — "Sons of Heaven" (LOGOS) + "joined" (PNEUMA); "associated" is stilted |
| 16 | 11:19 | "an-eternal-planting for-all-time that-shall-be" | "an eternal planting for all time to come" | "an eternal planting through all ages to come" | Word choice | LOGOS — "all time to come" suffices; "all ages" is expansive |
| 17 | 11:20 | "I-belong-to wicked-humanity" | "I belong to wicked humanity" | "I belong to sinful humanity" | Word choice | LOGOS — rish'ah = "wickedness" specifically, not generic "sinfulness" |
| 18 | 11:21 | "the-assembly-of worms" | "the assembly of worms" | "the realm of decay" | Interpretive | LOGOS — "assembly of worms" preserves the stark Hebrew metaphor; "realm of decay" abstracts it |
| 19 | 11:21 | "those-who-walk in-darkness" | "those who walk in darkness" | "those who stumble in the dark" | Word choice | LOGOS — "walk in darkness" is the Hebrew idiom; "stumble" adds meaning not present |
| 20 | 11:22 | "a-man does-not direct his-steps" | "a man does not direct his steps" | "no mortal directs their own steps" | Structural | LOGOS — "a man" preserves Hebrew gever; PNEUMA's "no mortal" + plural pronoun departs from source |

---

**Summary:** 20 disagreements logged. LOGOS prevailed in 18 cases, SOPHIA offered 1 compromise (11:18), and no pure EMET or PNEUMA readings were adopted. Column 11's deeply theological content and its echoes of biblical poetry (especially Jer 10:23) consistently favored formal equivalence. PNEUMA's renderings, while often beautiful, tended to normalize unusual Hebrew idioms ("opened my light," "assembly of worms," "rock of my steps") that carry theological weight in the Qumran context.
